headline: Today's sound headlines
lead: 30 new stories from 17 sound and audio news sources over the last 48 hours, including Sound On Sound, Production Expert, ProSoundWeb, FOH, TPi and 12 more. This edition is assembled automatically from the outlets' own feeds: titles and summaries are theirs, sorted into sections. Open a story for the full article.

items.title: Spitfire Audio LABS Discontinued, 2 Packs Left Behind In The Move To Splice INSTRUMENT
items.take: Spitfire Audio has discontinued its free LABS plugin and the LABS+ subscription, which stopped receiving updates, content and support on 31 October 2026. LABS content now lives in Splice INSTRUMENT, the plugin from Spitfire’s owner, Splice.

items.title: Meyer Sound Brings Germany’s First Tigra System to Alte Oper Frankfurt
items.take: FRANKFURT, Germany – The Alte Oper Frankfurt is home to the first Meyer Sound TIGRA™ line array system in Germany. Installed in the venue’s 2,400-seat Großer Saal, or Great Hall, the system is also the first TIGRA installation in Europe to operate on an entirely digital audio signal path.

items.title: Seek sick sets from SITKA, Zuggamasta, hellocatfood, in cables and code
items.take: It may seem the world is closing in, the internet is dying, tides of slop are rising -- don't believe it. The underground shares signs of hope, from Kyiv's SITKA to Köln's Zuggamasta to Earth's hellocatfood. It's got modules. It's got (entirely human!) coding. It's got trippy visuals.

items.title: Phonak and Pickleball: Serving Up Hearing Health Awareness
items.take: Phonak’s championship sponsorship and partnership with USA Pickleball aim to raise hearing health awareness and drive consumers to local clinics. This campaign leverages the sport's social nature to normalize hearing care and highlight modern technology.

items.title: Instagram Content Protection Launched – Automatic Repost Detection, Credit Links and AI Spoken-Word Matching Test
items.take: Meta has brought content protection to Instagram. The tool automatically scans Instagram and Facebook for copies of an enrolled creator’s original videos, sends an alert for each match, and lets the creator track it, hide it, add an “original by” credit link, or release it.

items.title: Spitfire Audio LABS sails off into the sunset. What happens now?
items.take: Spitfire Audio LABS is no more! Spitfire Audio initially launched LABS instruments for Kontakt as a donationware project. In 2018, the company reformatted LABS as a completely free entity with a dedicated plugin, and it quickly became a must-have for hordes of bedroom producers.

items.title: HearUSA Adds Widex Allure AI RIC to Premium Hearing Aid Portfolio
items.take: HearUSA has added the Widex Allure AI RIC to its nationwide portfolio, expanding patient access to the device's wearer-activated AI denoising and natural sound processing. The new offering also reintroduces Widex Zen Therapy to support patients managing tinnitus.

craft.body:
When your calendar is full, every extra job you accept at an old rate pushes out work you could have priced properly. Busy periods are when clients accept a rate rise most easily, because the alternative is waiting for someone else to be free.

Update your rate card for new clients, keep existing clients informed in writing with a date, and make the quote say exactly what is included: number of revision rounds, stem and alt-mix versions, loudness passes and turnaround. Anything beyond that is billed. It protects your income and your ears, because unpaid extra passes are also extra hours of listening.
craft.title: Price the busy season, not the quiet one
